passos.acao: Identificar o denominador para dividir a reta
Dividir a reta numérica em 5 partes iguais
Localizar a fração 3/5 na reta numérica
passos.valor: Ponto marcado na posição {A}/{B} = 3/5 na reta

erros.devolutiva: Relacionar explicitamente: denominador = total da tarefa = 5; usar blocos ou desenho para mostrar que a unidade corresponde a 5 livros.
erros.buggyRule: Usar o número de livros lidos ({numerador}) como o número de partes para dividir a reta, em vez do total de livros ({denominador}).

erros.devolutiva: Reforçar que a unidade (1) = total da tarefa = 5 livros; usar analogia com pizza de 5 fatias.
Usar frase modelo: 'li [numerador] de [denominador]'; destacar palavras-chave no enunciado ('5 books', '3 of the books').

dicas.texto: Boa observação! O denominador nos diz em quantas partes iguais devemos dividir o inteiro. Quantas partes iguais representa o número total de livros?
Você está no caminho certo! Digite o número total de livros no campo 'Number of parts' e clique em OK para dividir a reta corretamente.
Quase lá! A reta precisa ser dividida em exatamente 5 partes iguais. Verifique se o número que você digitou corresponde ao total de livros da tarefa.
Você está quase pronto! O total de livros é 5, então digite 5 no campo 'Number of parts' e clique em OK — isso vai dividir a reta em 5 partes iguais!
Ótima pergunta! Quando localizamos uma fração na reta, por onde começamos a contar as partes? Lembre-se: a primeira parte começa logo após o zero!
Continue assim! Comece no zero e conte cada divisão: a primeira marca é 1/5, a segunda é 2/5, e a terceira é...?
Muito bem! Você já dividiu a reta em 5 partes. Agora, marque o ponto exatamente na terceira divisão — não na quarta nem na segunda!
Você está quase lá! Conte comigo: primeiro traço = 1/5, segundo = 2/5, terceiro = ... agora marque esse ponto!
Pense bem: onde fica exatamente a metade entre 0 e 1 na reta numérica? E como comparar duas frações com denominadores diferentes?
Você pode imaginar ou desenhar mentalmente onde fica 1/2 na sua reta dividida em 5 partes. Em que posição ficaria? Depois compare com 3/5.
Dica útil: 1/2 equivale a 2,5/5. Então, qualquer fração maior que 2,5/5 é mais que a metade. 3/5 é maior que isso?
Veja: se a reta tem 5 partes, a metade está entre a segunda e a terceira marca. Como 3/5 está na terceira marca, ela está um pouco além da metade. Isso confirma a ideia de Sally?

dicas.texto: The numerator is the top number of a fraction and tells how many parts have been completed.
Look in the story for the number that tells how many books Sally has read so far.
Sally has read three books, so enter that count in the top fraction box.
Type the number of books already read into F1, using the count stated in the sentence about what Sally has read.

Find the number that represents all the books Sally must read, not just the books already finished.
The total assignment contains five books, and that total belongs in the bottom fraction box.

Use the total number of books as the number of equal parts, then confirm the division with OK.
The assignment has five equal book-sized parts, so set the Number of parts field to the assignment total.
Type the total number of books into Number of parts and press OK to create the matching equal intervals.
The numerator tells how many intervals to move from zero, and the denominator tells the size of the equal partition.
Start at 0 and count equal intervals toward 1 using the number of books Sally has read.
Move to the third division mark after 0 on the number line divided into five equal parts.
Click the third interval from 0, then submit the fraction represented by that marked position.
On a number line, a point farther to the right represents a greater amount.
Locate the halfway position between 0 and 1, then compare it with Sally's marked point.
Check whether Sally's point lies to the left of, exactly at, or to the right of the halfway position.
Drag the comparison marker to the side of the halfway point where Sally's marked point appears.
Before finishing, check that the marked point matches the fraction of the assignment that has been completed.
Review the fraction boxes, the number of equal parts, and the point marked on the number line.
Make sure the point is three equal intervals from zero on a line divided into five equal intervals.
When the fraction boxes and the marked point agree, press the Done button to submit the completed representation.

misconceptions.feedback: The mention of half is for comparison later. First, the denominator must represent the complete assignment of 5 books.

misconceptions.description: Aluno digita 6 em vez de 5, por contar marcas em vez de intervalos.
misconceptions.feedback: Count equal parts, not the endpoints of the number line. The complete assignment is divided into 5 parts.

nodes.description: Enter the number of equal parts and press OK to divide the number line.
nodes.instruction: Enter the number of equal parts and press OK to divide the number line.

hints.message: Each equal interval on the number line should represent one equal part of the whole assignment.
Use the total number of books as the number of equal parts, then confirm the division with OK.
The assignment has five equal book-sized parts, so set the Number of parts field to the assignment total.
Type the total number of books into Number of parts and press OK to create the matching equal intervals.

misconceptions.description: Aluno confunde o numerador (quantidade lida) com o denominador (total da tarefa) ao dividir a reta numérica.
misconceptions.feedback: The number of parts must represent the whole assignment, not only the books already read. Use the total number of books.

misconceptions.description: Aluno foca na comparação com metade e divide a reta em 2, não em 5.
misconceptions.feedback: Half is used for comparison, but it is not the number of parts for Sally's assignment. Divide the whole into parts matching the total books.

misconceptions.description: Aluno digita 6 em vez de 5, por contar marcas em vez de intervalos.
misconceptions.feedback: The field asks for intervals, not the number of endpoint marks. The assignment requires five equal intervals.

nodes.description: Mark the point on the number line that represents the fraction of the assignment Sally has read.
nodes.instruction: Mark the point on the number line that represents the fraction of the assignment Sally has read.

hints.message: The numerator tells how many intervals to move from zero, and the denominator tells the size of the equal partition.
Start at 0 and count equal intervals toward 1 using the number of books Sally has read.
Move to the third division mark after 0 on the number line divided into five equal parts.
Click the third interval from 0, then submit the fraction represented by that marked position.

misconceptions.description: Como o aluno dividiu a reta em 3 e o numerador é 3, ele marca no fim (1), interpretando como 'completo'.
misconceptions.feedback: The endpoint 1 means the entire assignment is complete. Reading 3 books out of 5 does not reach the endpoint.

misconceptions.description: Aluno trata o numerador como coordenada absoluta (ex: marca em 3), não como fração de 5.
misconceptions.feedback: The number line runs from 0 to 1, so the point cannot be placed at 3. Interpret the location as three of the five equal parts.

misconceptions.description: Aluno começa a contar as marcas a partir da primeira divisão (não do zero), resultando em posição errada.
misconceptions.feedback: Begin counting at 0. The third interval from 0 is needed, not the point one interval earlier.

nodes.description: Use the number line to compare Sally's point with the halfway point.
nodes.instruction: Use the number line to compare Sally's point with the halfway point.

hints.message: On a number line, a point farther to the right represents a greater amount.
Locate the halfway position between 0 and 1, then compare it with Sally's marked point.
Check whether Sally's point lies to the left of, exactly at, or to the right of the halfway position.
Drag the comparison marker to the side of the halfway point where Sally's marked point appears.

nodes.description: Press Done after verifying the fraction shown on the number line.
nodes.instruction: Press Done after verifying the fraction shown on the number line.

hints.message: Before finishing, check that the marked point matches the fraction of the assignment that has been completed.
Review the fraction boxes, the number of equal parts, and the point marked on the number line.
Make sure the point is three equal intervals from zero on a line divided into five equal intervals.
When the fraction boxes and the marked point agree, press the Done button to submit the completed representation.
